services.name: Set Sail Into History
services.desc: Thank you for joining us for an unforgettable cruise around beautiful Bainbridge Island, where history will come to life right before your eyes! We Set Sail Into History on July 20, 2025. As we glide through the scenic waters of the Puget Sound on the Argosy Goodtime II, a lineup of dynamic and engaging speakers-each with a unique connection to Bainbridge Island-will share captivating stories, local legends, and fascinating insights into the island’s rich past. It's approximately a 3-hour tour circumnavigating Bainbridge Island.
